Metadata.title: SQL Injection Lab — Interactive hands-on SQL injection training
Metadata.description: A safe, interactive lab to learn and practice SQL injection attacks against a real database, right in your browser. For educational purposes only.

Footer.tagline: An educational lab for safely experimenting with SQL Injection attacks.
Footer.educationalNotice: This tool is intended solely for educational purposes in a controlled environment.

hero.title: Learn SQL injection hands-on
hero.subtitle: An interactive lab where you attack a real SQLite database running entirely in your browser. No server, no risk — just you and the database.

realDb.title: Real database in the browser
realDb.description: Every task runs against an actual SQLite database via WebAssembly. Your injections truly execute — safely sandboxed in your browser.

tasks.title: Progressive tasks
tasks.description: From the basics to advanced techniques: union-based, error-based, tautologies, piggy-backed queries and more.

progress.title: Progress tracking
progress.description: Every attempt and result is saved to your account. Run multiple sessions and follow your progress.

custom.title: Custom task sets
custom.description: Import your own tasks as JSON and upload your own SQLite database. Build your own exercises.

union.title: Union-based injection
union.description: Append results from other tables to the output and exfiltrate sensitive data such as user passwords.

tautology.title: Tautologies
tautology.description: Bypass authentication with an always-true expression, for example ' OR '1'='1.

error.title: Error-based injection
error.description: Trigger error messages that leak the structure of the database.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.subtitle: Sign in with Google or GitHub and start training in seconds.

About.title: About
About.subtitle: SQL Injection Lab is an educational tool for understanding SQL injection attacks hands-on, in a safe environment.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: The goal of this project is to teach developers and students how SQL injection attacks work — so they can write safer code. The best way to defend against an attack is to understand it.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Every task runs against a real SQLite database executed directly in your browser via WebAssembly. Your injections genuinely execute, but everything happens locally and in isolation — no real systems are ever at risk.

safety.title: Safety and ethics
safety.body: This tool is intended solely for educational purposes. Never use the techniques you learn here against systems without explicit authorization. Unauthorized access to computer systems is a crime.

credits.title: About the author
credits.body: The project started as a school project at FIIT STU (BVI) and is further developed by kromka.it.
